name: Ancestor
description: Mysterious entity at the center of the Order's beliefs.

timeline.summary: In a Nomad myth, Eagle begs to be human at the Reapportionment and the Ancestor grants half the prayer.
timeline.quote: At the Reapportionment, Eagle begged to be human. The Ancestor granted half that prayer.

citation.text: Aven Cloudchaser (Tenth Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teshar believes the Ancestor saved them for a purpose.
timeline.quote: The Ancestor saved us for a purpose.

citation.text: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Teshar is the Ancestor's apostle and believes in being saved by them.
relations.quote: The Ancestor saved us for a purpose.
